Host test-only cJSON source
===========================

Upstream: https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON
Tag: v1.7.19
Files: cJSON.c, cJSON.h, LICENSE (MIT)

The firmware dependency is declared in main/idf_component.yml as
`espressif/cjson` version `1.7.19~2` and is resolved into managed_components by
the IDF component manager during Codex's build.  These files are only linked by
the host model/worker tests; no managed_components or vendor file is edited.
